"""Retains actual public CLI oracles with independently observed native compilers."""

from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys


root = Path.cwd()
scratch = Path('/tmp/aos-bazel-722')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools/bazel/tests'))
from verify_cache import execution_events
from inspect_compiler_execution import parse_execution_trace

nix = '/nix/store/ipbhyg77i2myf03bh1mrnyjkdmn9112b-nix-2.24.12/bin/nix'
store = '/nix/store/ipbhyg77i2myf03bh1mrnyjkdmn9112b-nix-2.24.12/bin/nix-store'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def recipe(output):
    drv = subprocess.check_output([store, '--query', '--deriver', str(output)], text=True).strip()
    values = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([nix, 'derivation', 'show', drv], text=True))
    assert len(values) == 1
    return {'output': str(output), 'derivation': drv, 'derivation_sha256': sha(drv)}, next(iter(values.values()))


prior = read(root / 'tools/bazel/tests/evidence/cli-strip-profiles.json')
outputs = (scratch / 'cli-observed-final-qualification.paths').read_text().splitlines()
assert len(outputs) == 3
probe = Path(outputs.pop())
families = {}
for name, output, cases in zip(['default', 'fleet'], outputs, [543, 551]):
    gate = Path(output)
    profiles = read(gate / 'execution-profiles.json')
    parity = read(gate / 'parity.json')
    native = read(gate / 'native-compiler-execution.json')
    defaults = read(gate / 'profile-semantics.json')
    assert profiles['status'] == 'PASS'
    assert sum(map(len, parity['cargo_executed'].values())) == cases
    binding = profiles['native_execution']
    assert binding['status'] == 'PASS'
    assert profiles['native_defaults']['status'] == 'PASS'
    assert native['tools']['rustc']['sha256'] == profiles['native_defaults']['compiler_sha256'] == binding['compiler_sha256']
    assert native['requested_compilation_inventory'] == binding['compilation_inventory']
    assert binding['compilation_inventory']['units'] == (639 if name == 'default' else 645)
    assert binding['compiler_sha256'] == defaults['tools_sha256'][defaults['compiler']['unwrapped']]
    assert profiles['strip_compared'] and profiles['external']['strip_compared']
    assert len(profiles['external']['units']) == 552
    assert len(profiles['external']['build_system_helpers']) == 4
    assert len(profiles['first_party_units']) == (79 if name == 'default' else 85)
    assert len(profiles['procedural_macros']) == 28

    build = Path(profiles['build'])
    cargo = Path(profiles['cargo'])
    assert str(build) != prior['families'][name]['build']
    assert str(cargo) != prior['families'][name]['compiler_profiles']['cargo']
    assert native['inputs_sha256']['execution'] == binding['execution_trace_sha256'] == sha(cargo / 'compiler-exec.log')
    assert native['inputs_sha256']['requested'] == sha(cargo / 'compiler-compile-arguments.jsonl')
    assert profiles['native_trace_sha256'] == sha(cargo / 'compiler-arguments.jsonl')
    events = execution_events(build)
    assert len(events) == (1261 if name == 'default' else 1270)
    assert all(row['runner'] == 'linux-sandbox' and not row['cacheHit'] and row['exitCode'] == 0 for row in events)

    build_info, build_recipe = recipe(build)
    native_info, native_recipe = recipe(cargo)
    source = Path(build_recipe['env']['src'])
    native_source = Path(native_recipe['env']['src'])
    inventory = read(build / 'inventory.json')
    hashes = {file: sha(source / file) for file in inventory['source_files']}
    assert all(sha(root / file) == value for file, value in hashes.items())
    rust_files = [file for file in hashes if file.endswith('.rs')]
    assert all(sha(native_source / file) == hashes[file] for file in rust_files)
    configs = set(re.findall(r'--config\s+(/nix/store/[^\s]+)', '\n'.join(build_recipe['args'])))
    assert len(configs) == 1
    configuration = Path(configs.pop())
    fixture = Path(read(configuration)['repositories']['aos_cli_test_sources'])
    manifest = read(fixture / 'manifest.json')['files']
    differences = []
    for file, entry in manifest.items():
        retained = fixture / 'source' / (file + '.aos-source')
        assert sha(retained) == entry['sha256'] and retained.stat().st_size == entry['size']
        if file != 'build/bazel-architecture.json' and sha(native_source / file) != entry['sha256']:
            differences.append(file)
    assert not differences, differences

    aggregate_info, aggregate_recipe = recipe(gate)
    matches = set(re.findall(r'(/nix/store/[^\s]+-test-profiles)/evidence\.json', '\n'.join(aggregate_recipe['args'])))
    assert len(matches) == 1, matches
    profile_output = Path(matches.pop())
    profile_info, profile_recipe = recipe(profile_output)
    assert (profile_output / 'evidence.json').read_bytes() == (gate / 'execution-profiles.json').read_bytes()
    verifiers = set(re.findall(r'(/nix/store/[^\s]+-aos-bazel-family-profile-verifier)/rust_profiles\.py', '\n'.join(profile_recipe['args'])))
    assert len(verifiers) == 1, verifiers
    verifier = Path(verifiers.pop())
    verifier_hashes = {}
    for file in verifier.iterdir():
        relative = 'tools/bazel/qualification/' + file.name
        assert sha(file) == sha(root / relative), relative
        verifier_hashes[relative] = sha(file)
    matches = set(re.findall(r"'--native-execution' '(/nix/store/[^']+)/execution\.json'", '\n'.join(profile_recipe['args'])))
    assert len(matches) == 1, matches
    inspection_output = Path(matches.pop())
    inspection_info, inspection_recipe = recipe(inspection_output)
    assert (inspection_output / 'execution.json').read_bytes() == (gate / 'native-compiler-execution.json').read_bytes()
    assert (inspection_output / 'toolchain-closure.json').read_bytes() == (gate / 'native-toolchain-closure.json').read_bytes()
    tools = set(re.findall(r'(/nix/store/[^\s]+-aos-compiler-execution-tools)/inspect_compiler_execution\.py', '\n'.join(inspection_recipe['args'])))
    assert len(tools) == 1, tools
    tools = Path(tools.pop())
    assert sha(tools / 'inspect_compiler_execution.py') == sha(root / 'tools/bazel/tests/inspect_compiler_execution.py')
    inputs = read(inspection_output / 'inputs.json')
    assert inputs['cargo'] == str(cargo)
    assert inputs['compiler_arguments'] == str(cargo / 'compiler-compile-arguments.jsonl')

    strict = parse_execution_trace((cargo / 'compiler-exec.log').read_text())
    assert not strict['unresolved_task_records']
    assert sum(row['executable'] == native['tools']['rustc']['path'] for row in strict['executions']) == native['compiler_invocations']

    families[name] = {
        'strict_capture_reaudit': {'successful_exec_calls': len(strict['executions']), 'failed_exec_attempts': strict['failed_exec_attempts'], 'unresolved_task_records': strict['unresolved_task_records']},
        'aggregate': aggregate_info, 'cases': cases,
        'build': build_info, 'cargo': native_info,
        'source': str(source), 'native_source': str(native_source),
        'source_files_checked': len(hashes), 'rust_sources_equal_to_native': len(rust_files),
        'source_hashes_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(hashes, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
        'fixture': str(fixture), 'fixture_files_checked': len(manifest),
        'fixture_manifest_sha256': sha(fixture / 'manifest.json'),
        'fixture_differences_from_native': differences,
        'configuration': str(configuration), 'configuration_sha256': sha(configuration),
        'executed_actions': len(events), 'mnemonics': dict(Counter(row['mnemonic'] for row in events)),
        'build_evidence_sha256': profiles['evidence_sha256'],
        'native_trace_sha256': profiles['native_trace_sha256'],
        'profiles': {**profile_info, 'report_sha256': sha(profile_output / 'evidence.json'),
                     'source': str(verifier), 'source_sha256': verifier_hashes},
        'native_defaults_binding': profiles['native_defaults'], 'native_execution_binding': binding,
        'native_inspection': {**inspection_info, 'report_sha256': sha(inspection_output / 'execution.json'),
                              'source': str(tools), 'source_sha256': sha(tools / 'inspect_compiler_execution.py'),
                              'toolchain_closure_sha256': sha(inspection_output / 'toolchain-closure.json')},
        'execution_capture': native['execution_capture'],
        'native_tools': native['tools'], 'native_executable_counts': native['executable_counts'],
        'requested_invocations': native['requested_invocations'],
        'observed_rustc_invocations': native['compiler_invocations'],
        'direct_version_queries': native['direct_version_queries'],
        'native_compiler_and_linker_commands': len(native['native_executions']),
        'unexpanded_native_response_arguments': sorted({argument
            for row in native['native_executions'] for argument in row['arguments']
            if argument.startswith('@')}),
        'profiles_sha256': sha(gate / 'execution-profiles.json'),
        'parity_sha256': sha(gate / 'parity.json'),
        'strip_semantics_sha256': sha(gate / 'strip-semantics.json'),
        'profile_semantics_sha256': sha(gate / 'profile-semantics.json'),
    }
    print(name, cases, 'cases;', len(events), 'uncached Linux actions;', binding['compilation_inventory']['units'], 'observed native source requests', flush=True)

checks = (scratch / 'cli-observed-execution-checks.paths').read_text().splitlines()
assert len(checks) == 3
registered = {}
for name, output in zip(['checks.eval', 'checks.build.bazel.policy', 'checks.build.bazel.source-selection'], checks):
    assert (Path(output) / 'result').read_text().strip() == 'PASS'
    registered[name] = {'output': output, 'result_sha256': sha(Path(output) / 'result')}
policy_counts = re.findall(r'Ran (\d+) tests', (scratch / 'cli-observed-execution-checks.log').read_text())
assert policy_counts == ['386'], policy_counts
profile_counts = re.findall(r'Ran (\d+) tests', (scratch / 'cli-observed-final-qualification.log').read_text())
assert profile_counts == ['38', '38'], profile_counts

controls = {}
for name, path in {
    'default': '/nix/store/34gxmlzhrhdvfdvk21vadnn5gj9b3hv2-aos-bazel-aos-cli-cargo-1',
    'fleet': '/nix/store/1jsns61w12b3xh9sb8ilhrck7pinajl1-aos-bazel-aos-cli-fleet-cargo-1',
}.items():
    trace = Path(path) / 'compiler-exec.log'
    try:
        parse_execution_trace(trace.read_text())
    except ValueError as error:
        controls[name] = {'trace': str(trace), 'sha256': sha(trace), 'strict_parser_rejected': True, 'reason': str(error), 'undecoded_records': [line for line in trace.read_text().splitlines() if '???(' in line]}
    else:
        raise ValueError('known incomplete capture was accepted')

report = {
    'schema_version': 1, 'status': 'PASS',
    'scope': 'Actual public ordinary/fleet CLI oracles with independent native compiler execution, exact unit/profile/case parity and uncached Linux sandbox compilation.',
    'families': families, 'registered_checks': registered,
    'capture_conformance': {'output': str(probe), 'report': read(probe / 'evidence.json'), 'report_sha256': sha(probe / 'evidence.json')},
    'rejected_incomplete_native_controls': controls,
    'tracer_repair_claimed': False,
    'rejected_kernel_filter_control': {'derivation': '/nix/store/8216x522niay4rm503h2bw6sw17wdd02-aos-bazel-compiler-trace-conformance.drv', 'log_sha256': sha(scratch / 'compiler-trace-kernel-filter-rejected.log'), 'undecoded_records': [line for line in (scratch / 'compiler-trace-kernel-filter-rejected.log').read_text().splitlines() if 'Unsupported capture record:' in line]},
    'complete_execution_capture': 'Unqualified when unresolved task records are present; requested-command coverage is a separate proof.',
    'policy_test_count': 386, 'profile_test_count': 38,
    'command': 'nix-build tools/bazel/tests/aos-cli.nix -A default.oracle -A fleet.oracle -A compiler-trace-conformance --no-out-link --keep-going --max-jobs 2 --cores 4 --option substitute false',
    'source_sha256': {file: sha(root / file) for file in [
        'tests/build/_bazel-aos-cli-cargo.nix', 'tests/build/_bazel-cargo-oracle.nix',
        'tests/build/_bazel-compiler-execution.nix', 'tests/build/_bazel-aos-cli.nix',
        'tools/bazel/qualification/rust-profiles.nix', 'tools/bazel/qualification/rust_profiles.py',
        'tools/bazel/qualification/test_rust_profiles.py', 'tools/bazel/tests/aos-cli.nix',
        'tools/bazel/tests/inspect_compiler_execution.py', 'tools/bazel/tests/test_compiler_execution.py',
        'tools/bazel/tests/test_native_profile_defaults.py',
        'tools/bazel/qualification/compiler-trace.nix', 'tools/bazel/qualification/compiler_trace.py',
    ]},
    'limits': [
        'Undecoded task records never count as executed compiler commands and remain visible; a capture containing them fails the separate complete-execution gate.',
        'Compilation is traced with source-built strace; test execution is untraced. Tracer overhead makes these runs unsuitable as performance acceptance measurements.',
        'The native source-request fingerprint excludes queries without positional Rust source paths; every request in the traced phase is separately matched against observed unwrapped execution.',
        'Native GCC/linker execution and closure are observed, but native options and response-file contents are not qualified against Bazel here.',
        'Incremental codegen and codegen-unit defaults, complete compiler options, ABI/runtime/editor/release/foreign qualification, numeric performance, production migration and Cargo removal remain separate acceptance work.',
    ],
    'retention_harness': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
(root / 'tools/bazel/tests/evidence/cli-observed-native-execution.json').write_text(
    json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
print('PASS: retained actual public oracles with independently observed source-built native compilers')
